# cube_uniform
subsection Vascularization
  subsection Discretization
    set Exterior target length = 0
    set Lower length factor    = 0.5
    set Numerical cell budget  = 1000000
    set Target length factor   = 1
    set Upper length factor    = 2
  end
  subsection Domain
    set Cube origin          = 0,0,0
    set Cube side length     = 1
    set Edge axis            = 2
    set Edge sides           = 0,0
    set Refinement focus     = none
    set Refinement fractions = .5,.25,.125
    set Shape                = cube
    set Sphere center        = .5,.5,.5
    set Sphere radius        = .5
    set Uniform refinements  = 2
  end
  subsection Growth
    set Candidate vessels          = 12
    set Clearance                  = 0
    set Dissipation weight         = 0
    set Geometry patch budget      = 100000
    set Geometry subdivision depth = 18
    set Local optimization steps   = 10
    set Minimum junction angle     = 15
    set Minimum vessel length      = 0
    set Seed length                = .15
  end
  subsection Input and ports
    set Evaluate reference      = true
    set Input archive           =
    set Mode                    = generate
    set Seed direction          = 1,0,0
    set Seed inward port normal = 0, 0, 0
    set Seed position           = .2,.5,.5
    set Seed radius             = .003
    set Selected terminal ids   =
  end
  subsection Objectives
    set Calibration attempt budget = 12
    set Coverage quadrature order  = 2
    set Maximum new terminals      = 128
    set Maximum service distance   = .2
    set Minimum new terminals      = 32
    set Minimum tissue coverage    = .25
    set Target volume fraction     = 4.6e-5
    set Volume relative tolerance  = .05
  end
  subsection Output
    set Directory             = <run>/cube_uniform
    set Save physical archive = true
    set Write meshes          = true
    set Write tables          = true
  end
  subsection Physiology
    set Arterial Murray exponent          = 3
    set Dynamic viscosity                 = .004
    set Loaded tissue reference flow      = 0
    set Minimum radius                    = 0
    set Reference absolute flow tolerance = 0
    set Reference conservation tolerance  = 1e-09
    set Reference iteration budget        = 10000
    set Reference linear tolerance        = 1e-12
    set Reference pressures               = 0:12000
    set Tissue demand                     = 1
    set Total new-tissue reference flow   = 2e-9
    set Unpaired reference inflows        =
  end
  subsection Sampling
    set Density mesh exponent       = 0
    set Random seed                 = 23
    set Sample budget per insertion = 2000
    set Spatial weight              = 1
    set Spatial weight bound        = 1
    set Terminal count              = 64
  end
  subsection Venous network
    set Enabled                  = false
    set Microvascular resistance = 0
    set Murray exponent          = 3
    set Seed inward port normal  = 0, 0, 0
    set Seed position            = 0, 0, 0
    set Seed radius              = 0
    set Selected terminal ids    =
    set Terminal separation      = 0
  end
end

# arteriovenous
subsection Vascularization
  subsection Discretization
    set Exterior target length = 0
    set Lower length factor    = 0.5
    set Numerical cell budget  = 1000000
    set Target length factor   = 1
    set Upper length factor    = 2
  end
  subsection Domain
    set Cube origin          = 0,0,0
    set Cube side length     = 1
    set Edge axis            = 2
    set Edge sides           = 0,0
    set Refinement focus     = none
    set Refinement fractions = .5,.25,.125
    set Shape                = cube
    set Sphere center        = .5,.5,.5
    set Sphere radius        = .5
    set Uniform refinements  = 2
  end
  subsection Growth
    set Candidate vessels          = 12
    set Clearance                  = 0
    set Dissipation weight         = 0
    set Geometry patch budget      = 100000
    set Geometry subdivision depth = 18
    set Local optimization steps   = 10
    set Minimum junction angle     = 15
    set Minimum vessel length      = 0
    set Seed length                = .15
  end
  subsection Input and ports
    set Evaluate reference      = true
    set Input archive           =
    set Mode                    = generate
    set Seed direction          = 1,0,0
    set Seed inward port normal = 0, 0, 0
    set Seed position           = .2,.5,.5
    set Seed radius             = .003
    set Selected terminal ids   =
  end
  subsection Objectives
    set Calibration attempt budget = 12
    set Coverage quadrature order  = 2
    set Maximum new terminals      = 128
    set Maximum service distance   = .2
    set Minimum new terminals      = 32
    set Minimum tissue coverage    = .6
    set Target volume fraction     = 1.26e-4
    set Volume relative tolerance  = .05
  end
  subsection Output
    set Directory             = <run>/arteriovenous
    set Save physical archive = true
    set Write meshes          = true
    set Write tables          = true
  end
  subsection Physiology
    set Arterial Murray exponent          = 3
    set Dynamic viscosity                 = .004
    set Loaded tissue reference flow      = 0
    set Minimum radius                    = 0
    set Reference absolute flow tolerance = 0
    set Reference conservation tolerance  = 1e-09
    set Reference iteration budget        = 10000
    set Reference linear tolerance        = 1e-12
    set Reference pressures               = 0:12000,2:4000
    set Tissue demand                     = 1
    set Total new-tissue reference flow   = 2e-9
    set Unpaired reference inflows        =
  end
  subsection Sampling
    set Density mesh exponent       = 0
    set Random seed                 = 23
    set Sample budget per insertion = 2000
    set Spatial weight              = 1
    set Spatial weight bound        = 1
    set Terminal count              = 64
  end
  subsection Venous network
    set Enabled                  = true
    set Microvascular resistance = 0
    set Murray exponent          = 3
    set Seed inward port normal  = 0, 0, 0
    set Seed position            = .8,.5,.5
    set Seed radius              = .004
    set Selected terminal ids    =
    set Terminal separation      = .04
  end
end

# rediscretized
subsection Vascularization
  subsection Discretization
    set Exterior target length = 0
    set Lower length factor    = .25
    set Numerical cell budget  = 1000000
    set Target length factor   = .5
    set Upper length factor    = 2
  end
  subsection Domain
    set Cube origin          = 0, 0, 0
    set Cube side length     = 1
    set Edge axis            = 2
    set Edge sides           = 0, 0
    set Refinement focus     = none
    set Refinement fractions = 0.5, 0.25, 0.125
    set Shape                = cube
    set Sphere center        = 0.5, 0.5, 0.5
    set Sphere radius        = 0.5
    set Uniform refinements  = 4
  end
  subsection Growth
    set Candidate vessels          = 12
    set Clearance                  = 0
    set Dissipation weight         = 0
    set Geometry patch budget      = 100000
    set Geometry subdivision depth = 18
    set Local optimization steps   = 10
    set Minimum junction angle     = 15
    set Minimum vessel length      = 0
    set Seed length                = 0
  end
  subsection Input and ports
    set Evaluate reference      = true
    set Input archive           = <run>/cube_uniform/network
    set Mode                    = load
    set Seed direction          = 0, 0, 0
    set Seed inward port normal = 0, 0, 0
    set Seed position           = 0, 0, 0
    set Seed radius             = 0
    set Selected terminal ids   =
  end
  subsection Objectives
    set Calibration attempt budget = 12
    set Coverage quadrature order  = 2
    set Maximum new terminals      = 10000
    set Maximum service distance   = .2
    set Minimum new terminals      = 1
    set Minimum tissue coverage    = 0
    set Target volume fraction     = 0
    set Volume relative tolerance  = 0.05
  end
  subsection Output
    set Directory             = <run>/rediscretized
    set Save physical archive = true
    set Write meshes          = true
    set Write tables          = true
  end
  subsection Physiology
    set Arterial Murray exponent          = 3
    set Dynamic viscosity                 = 0
    set Loaded tissue reference flow      = 2e-9
    set Minimum radius                    = 0
    set Reference absolute flow tolerance = 0
    set Reference conservation tolerance  = 1e-09
    set Reference iteration budget        = 10000
    set Reference linear tolerance        = 1e-12
    set Reference pressures               = 0:12000
    set Tissue demand                     = 1
    set Total new-tissue reference flow   = 0
    set Unpaired reference inflows        =
  end
  subsection Sampling
    set Density mesh exponent       = 0
    set Random seed                 = 1
    set Sample budget per insertion = 2000
    set Spatial weight              = 1
    set Spatial weight bound        = 1
    set Terminal count              = 1
  end
  subsection Venous network
    set Enabled                  = false
    set Microvascular resistance = 0
    set Murray exponent          = 3
    set Seed inward port normal  = 0, 0, 0
    set Seed position            = 0, 0, 0
    set Seed radius              = 0
    set Selected terminal ids    =
    set Terminal separation      = 0
  end
end
